main_text.head: NOBILITATE AC PRVDENTIA ORNA-tiffimis viris, Confulibus, atque Senatui, Ecclefiæq; Imperialis Reipub. Colmariensium, Dominis suis plurimum obseruandis, fauorem & pacem à Deo patre per Iefum Chriftum, optat Ioannes Brandmil-lerus.

p.i: ST HOC NON folum in more pofitum, institutoq; maiorum viri præstantissimi, sed etiam hodie in commu-ni vsu ac confuetudi-ne, vt, quando matrimonia contrahuntur & confirmantur, imo ante nuptiarum celebrationem in ipsis sponsalibus, mortis fiat mentio, tum viri, tum mulieris, hoc est, ambarum personarum, quæ in matrimonio collocantur. page.notes: The first line of the body text ("ST HOC NON") is set in spaced capitals beside a woodcut ornamental initial; the initial itself is an ornament, not a readable letter, so only the printed capitals are given. The faint marks at the upper right edge are show-through or scan edge and were left out. The word "Ecclefiæq;" is partly worn in the scan; the letters given are the most likely reading.
